note: Debut-volume manga (no light novels) from September 23 through October 2026, plus November debuts with confirmed dates. In Such a Small World and Elden Ring: Become Lord are announced but have no confirmed date yet. Links go to Barnes & Noble.

items.t: Witching Hour, Vol. 1
items.why: Paru Itagaki (Beastars) on a bored wife's affair with a ghost. Mature, character-driven seinen that sits with Look Back and The Summer Hikaru Died on Dan's shelf.

items.t: The Apothecary Diaries: Maomao's Notes on the Inner Palace, Vol. 1
items.why: The other manga adaptation of the novels, drawn by Minoji Kurata. Cat collects the Square Enix version, so this is a second take on her favorite mystery for her shelf.

items.t: The Dunwich Horror
items.why: Gou Tanabe's Lovecraft adaptation in one book. Horror and a literary adaptation at once, so it fits Cat's Junji Ito and Manga Classics shelf and Dan's horror.

items.t: The Apothecary Diaries: Xiaolan's Story, Vol. 1
items.meta: Oct 6 · Square Enix · palace mystery spinoff
items.why: The official spinoff told from Xiaolan's side. Same publisher as the Apothecary Diaries run Cat already owns.

items.t: Erin the Beast Player 1
items.why: Adapts Nahoko Uehashi's novel about an exiled girl raised among beasts. A literary adaptation for Cat, next to her Manga Classics and Ascendance of a Bookworm.

items.t: Yona of the Dawn (3-in-1 Edition), Vol. 1
items.why: A deposed princess and her guard on the run. Long-running shojo romance with a historical court setting, in Cat's lane next to The Apothecary Diaries.

items.t: Fan/Girl x Call/Boy, Vol. 1
items.why: A shut-in otaku hires a call boy who turns out to love her favorite game. Pitched for Sweat and Soap readers, which Cat owns, and close to Dan's I Want a Gal Gamer to Praise Me.

items.t: The Dragon School Is Atop the Mountain
items.why: Ryoko Kui (Delicious in Dungeon) short stories. Grounded fantasy for Dan's shelf next to Frieren and Witch Hat Atelier.

items.t: Asobi Asobase Omnibus, Vol. 1
items.why: Three schoolgirls in a games club that escalates fast. Fits Dan's comedy shelf with Bocchi the Rock! and Komi Can't Communicate.

items.t: -N, Vol. 1
items.why: Disappearances and a class massacre linked by the letter N. Dark mystery for either shelf, next to Paranoia Cage and Alice in Borderland.

items.t: Two A.M. at the Dining Table, Vol. 1
items.meta: Nov 3 · Yen Press · ghost family drama
items.why: A woman's late mother returns as a tiny doll-like ghost. Quiet grief story for Dan, closer to Look Back than to horror.

items.t: Non and Akari: The Complete Omnibus
items.why: A girl befriends the cursed doll in her new house. Whole story in one book, light horror for Cat.

items.t: The Seaside Where Dragon Boys Dwell, Vol. 1
items.why: A young woman meets a dragon boy in a seaside folk town. Gentle romance for Cat.

items.t: How to Keep a Human, Vol. 1
items.why: Monsters discover humans make good pets. In the Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid space on Dan's shelf.

items.t: Stalker Stalks Stalker, Vol. 1
items.why: Three college students each secretly stalking the next. One-joke romcom for Dan's comedy lane.

items.t: Albus Changes the World, Vol. 1
items.why: A hero speed-runs his quest by rewinding time. Shonen action for Dan if Undead Unluck's loop stuff landed.

items.t: Babanba BanBan Vampire, Vol. 1
items.why: A 450-year-old vampire guards a boy's virginity for his blood. Mature gag comedy, between Dan's and Cat's lanes.

items.t: My Journey to Her
items.why: Yuna Hirasawa's Eisner-winning memoir, now in print. A single, personal volume.

items.t: Living with My Old Cat, Vol. 1
items.why: Full-color life with a senior cat. Sweet but slight, a gift-shelf book next to Cat's Junji Ito's Cat Diary.

items.t: Meiji-Era Master-and-Servant Tungsten, Vol. 1
items.why: An engineer and his attendant building a power plant in 1900s Japan. Historical setting may interest Cat; retailers shelve it as BL.

items.t: Full Metal Panic! Family, Vol. 1
items.meta: Nov 3 · Yen Press · mecha family comedy
items.why: The original cast twenty years on, raising kids. Mostly for existing Full Metal Panic! fans.

items.t: GalaXic Baseball League, Vol. 1
items.why: Acky Bright's MLB-licensed space baseball. A tie-in more than a series.

items.t: Fate/Prototype: Fragments of Sky Silver, Vol. 1
items.why: A 1991 Holy Grail War. Franchise reading only.

items.t: Fate Rewinder: All Great Achievements Require Time, Vol. 1
items.why: An agency that rescues people from bad fates. Standard premise.

items.t: The Record of Fantastical Nomenclature, Vol. 1
items.why: A man who sees hidden creatures is hired to catalog them. Quiet, could go either way.

items.t: Tokujo-chan: The Girls Who Brighten Your Day
items.why: Illustrated everyday-girl vignettes. Closer to an art book than a story.

items.t: Resident Evil: Death Island, Vol. 1
items.why: Film adaptation for franchise fans.

items.t: Defying Expectations with Gravity Magic to Be Unparalleled, Vol. 1
items.why: Reincarnated adventurer with secretly overpowered magic. Outside both lanes.
